issues.evidence: accident_report_signed.pdf, section 14 Observations, Driver A (Lucas Bernard, policy VER-1002, Renault Clio GK-904-TR): "I moved into the left lane without seeing vehicle B in my blind spot. I accept that the accident is my fault." This signed joint accident report directly contradicts the recorded fact. The error also breaks the deductible logic: Article 5.2 of the Veridia contract (2630#10414, page 2) waives the C2 deductible only when the authorised driver is NOT at fault and the third party is identified; with fault admitted, the standard C2 deductible (€300, Article 2) applies, plus the young-driver surcharge of €400 under Article 5.3 because the licence date in the Policy Schedule (2024-09-02) is less than 3 years before the incident (2026-10-14) — so the staged €0 deductible / €2400 payout rests on a wrong fact.

verdict.summary: All other facts check out (policy VER-1002, C2 collision coverage in the Policy Schedule, incident 2026-10-14 reported 2026-10-15 within the 5-day deadline of Article 4.1, repair cost €2,400 = total incl. VAT on quote Q-2610-5172 per Article 1, third party Julie Laurent identified as a private car so the commercial-vehicle playbook rule does not apply, all three C2-required documents provided and belonging to this policyholder and vehicle, no exclusion under Article 3, assessor correctly booked since €2,400 > €1,500 per Article 6), but the claim was recorded as not-at-fault while the signed accident report has the policyholder admitting fault, which invalidates the €0 deductible and the €2,400 payout as staged.
